otter.name: The Devin Otter
otter.goal: Convince the otter you're a real Glaswegian
otter.greeting: Ye're no fae roon here, are ye? Prove it.
otter.win: The Devin Otter says you're a real Glaswegian!
otter.bust: Busted! The otter spotted the tourist.

senga.name: Senga the seagull
senga.goal: Order your chips like a real Glaswegian
senga.greeting: Right, whit're ye havin'? Hurry up, there's a queue!
senga.win: Senga slipped you a free pizza crunch!

hamish.name: Big Hamish
hamish.goal: Get on the bus like a real Glaswegian
hamish.greeting: Where ye gaun, pal? Ah've no got all day.
hamish.win: "On ye go, son." Big Hamish let you on!
hamish.bust: "Next!" Big Hamish shut the doors on you.
